messages.subject: Project Lyra — instruction to act on HRX-218 in-licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed on the call, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter to act for Hartwell on the in-licensing of the HRX-218 KRAS G12C series from Calderbrook Oncology. Stephen is leading the science side; Gregory will handle the commercials; Naomi and I will be your main contacts on the legals.

Can you send across an engagement letter and a first cut of a confidentiality agreement so we can get Calderbrook signed up before they share the data room?

Thanks,
Helena

messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached — please countersign and return at your convenience. James Osei (cc'd) will be your day-to-day senior associate, with Elena Marchetti supporting; we'll co-ordinate the patent diligence with Dr Foster at Hartington IP.

I'll send a draft mutual NDA tomorrow so we can get Calderbrook signed up and the data room opened.

Best,
Sarah
